title: Concept: HTTPS response redirects to a plaintext URL
description: An https response sent the client to a plaintext URL. The redirect itself is not the exposure: the exposure is that the follow-up request, with whatever credentials or session state the browser attaches to that host, is readable and modifiable on the path. TLS on the first hop does not extend to the second.
applicability: HTTPS responses that issue a redirect to a browser or API client.
risk: Session material and credentials exposed on the second hop; MEDIUM severity.
